messages:
chloe (AE): AcmeCorp POC hit spikes of 5xxs during a demo rehearsal at ~11:00 PT. Need a quick swarm.
jamal (SE): Which region/pool and any request ids?
chloe (AE): Hosted, us-west1, pool acme-poc. Devon shared rids: acme-0310-x, acme-0310-y. Burst pattern was steady 35RPS with short spikes up to 130.
devon (customer): We ran the CI load: `for i in 1..800; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done`
alex (SRE): Host logs show: `[2026-03-10T18:00:21Z] r=acme-0310-x status=503 reason=queue_overflow queue=610 limit=600` and `[2026-03-10T18:00:22Z] r=acme-0310-y status=502 reason=kernel_oom host=gpu-04`. Autoscaler triggered but ready in ~50s.
maria (Eng): Two issues: backlog exceeded + transient kernel OOM. Fast fixes: enable model fallback to redwood-medium, bump min_replicas to 3, or route to warm burstpool.
jamal (SE): I'll paste a client retry snippet and recommend jittered backoff. Also suggest temporarily turning off `prefer_region` so model fallback is prioritized.
alex (SRE): I can apply changes now: set min_replicas=3 and enable fallback for acme-customer. Cost impact minimal for demo window.
chloe (AE): Please do. Also ask Acme to add retry jitter in their harness.
alex (SRE): Done: `min_replicas=3` applied, `routing.fallback=[redwood-medium]` enabled, burstpool warmed with 3 instances. Cleared queued requests.
devon (customer): Rerunning now, will report back in ~90s.
jamal (SE): Note: if kernel OOMs persist after fallback, we may need to pin to different instance types or reduce model sequence lengths.
maria (Eng): Filing INF-6482 to reduce autoscaler cold startup from ~50s to <20s. Adding logs and reproducer.
alex (SRE): Monitoring adjusted: lower queue alert threshold for POCs to 400. We'll run a short blast test tomorrow.
devon (customer): Rerun looks good: only a couple of early 503s, then stable. p50 ~80ms, p95 ~410ms. Demoable.
chloe (AE): Great work. Follow-ups: add POC runbook (pre-warm min_replicas, enable fallback, burstpool), client-side backoff sample, and engineering ticket for autoscale latency. I'll update the deal thread.
jamal (SE): I'll add the runbook snippet and code sample.
alex (SRE): Closing the triage here. If Acme needs a permanent change we'll propose a Dedicated pool or higher baseline.
devon (customer): Thanks team, appreciate the quick response :thumbsup:
